src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s:
Which of the following statement/statements can best describe the nature of security concerns/ developments for India?
I. The development of the Hambantota Development Zone can be seen or viewed as a policy of containment funded by Pakistan.
II. India's support in building the Chabahar port in Iran may serve as a strategic act to balance the Chinese-funded Gwadar port in Yemen.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s:
Pick out the odd pairs with regard to newly elected Presidents of that respective country:

I. Fernando Pérez Molina: Guatemala

II. Abdel Fattah El-Sisi : Egypt

III. Felix Tshisekedi: Democratic Republic of the Congo

IV. Sierra Leone: Liberia
x:
Official key: I and IV. Strictly only IV is wrong – Otto Fernando Pérez Molina was Guatemala's President (elected 2011), so pair I is odd only as 'not newly elected' (general knowledge, not checked).
Pair IV is plainly odd – Sierra Leone is a country, not a President of Liberia. Pairs II (Sisi – Egypt) and III (Tshisekedi – DRC, elected 2018/19) are correct. Option 4 is the only code containing IV; the examiner treats I as odd too, as Guatemala's President was Otto (Fernando) Pérez Molina (2012–15, resigned) – not a 'newly elected' President.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s:
Consider the following statements about MILAN 2024:
I. MILAN 2024 is the 12th edition of Multilateral Naval Exercise being held from 19th to 27th February, 2024 under the aegis of Southern Naval Command.
II. The Harbour phase of MILAN 2024 is from 19th to 25th February, 2024 and is aimed towards building upon the experience of multilateral forces operating together at sea.
III. The Sea phase of MILAN 2024 is being conducted from 22nd to 27th February, 2024 and provides a platform for participating navies to discuss maritime subjects of common interest and share solutions.
Which among the above given statements are correct?
x: None is correct. I – MILAN 2024 (12th edition, 19–27 Feb 2024) was hosted at Visakhapatnam by the Eastern Naval Command, not the Southern. II – the harbour phase ran 19–23 Feb (seminar, city parade, discussions), and 'operating together at sea' describes the sea phase. III – the sea phase ran 24–27 Feb, and 'discussing maritime subjects' describes the harbour phase.

src: UPSC CSE Prelims 2024
s:
Which of the following statements about 'Exercise Mitra Shakti-2023' are correct?
1. This was a joint military exercise between India and Bangladesh.
2. It commenced in Aundh (Pune).
3. Joint response during counter-terrorism operations was a goal of this operation.
4. Indian Air Force was a part of this exercise Select the answer using the code given below:
x: Mitra Shakti is the India–Sri Lanka army exercise (1 is wrong). The 9th edition (16–29 August 2023) was at Aundh, Pune, on counter-terrorism operations under a UN mandate, and for the first time the IAF took part – 2, 3 and 4 correct (UPSC key d).

src: APPSC Assistant Director of Fisheries in A.P. Fisheries Serv
s: What is the name of the Indo-Mongolian Joint Military Exercise conducted in April, 2017?
x: Nomadic Elephant is the India–Mongolia joint military exercise; its 12th edition was held in April 2017 (Mongolia). Holy Cow, Raging Bull and Galloping Horse are invented names.

src: APPSC Junior Lecturers General Studies & Mental Ability 2020
s: The "MITRA SHAKTI-2019" was a joint military training exercise between
x: Mitra Shakti is the India–Sri Lanka joint army exercise; Mitra Shakti-2019 (7th edition) was held at Aundh, Pune. India–Nepal is Surya Kiran.

src: APPSC Divisional Accounts Officer (Mains) General Studies &
s: When was the joint military exercise between India and Thailand, named MAITREE 2019, held?
x: MAITREE 2019, the India–Thailand army exercise, was held at the Foreign Training Node, Umroi (Meghalaya), 16–29 September 2019. (MAITREE 2026 = 15th edition, Surat Thani, Thailand.)

src: APPSC Fisheries Development Officer, Sericulture Officer, Ag
s: In August 2022, which of the following countries along with the US and Japan kicked off a combined ballistic missile defence exercise in waters off Hawaii?
x: Pacific Dragon 2022 (August 2022, off Hawaii) was a ballistic-missile-defence exercise of the US, Japan and South Korea (with Australia and Canada) – the first such trilateral drill publicised in years.

src: APSLPRB SI 2023
s: The 7th edition of joint military exercise "Ajeya Warrior - 2023" was conducted between India and the following country
x: Ajeya Warrior is the India–United Kingdom joint army exercise; its 7th edition (April–May 2023) was held at Salisbury Plains, UK.

src: APPSC Forest Range Officer Paper (S1) 2023
s: Defence Minister Rajnath Singh addressed the strategically significant India-____ Army chiefs' conclave in Pune on 28 March 2023.
x: The India–Africa Army Chiefs' Conclave was held in Pune on 28 March 2023 alongside the AFINDEX-23 exercise; Rajnath Singh addressed it.

src: TSPSC Group-1 Preliminary Test 2022
s:
What is "Exercise VINBAX 2022" ?

A. It is the 3rd edition of Vietnam-India bilateral army drill.

B. It is held at the Dalhousie Cantonment, Himachal Pradesh.

C. It is held at the Chandi Mandir Military Station, Haryana.

D. The last such drill was held in Vietnam in 2019.

E. The Exercise was focused on deployment of army engineers and medical teams in United Nations peacekeeping operations.
Choose the correct answer:
x: VINBAX 2022 (1–20 August 2022) was the 3rd India–Vietnam army exercise, held at Chandimandir Military Station, Haryana, on deploying army engineer and medical teams for UN peacekeeping; the previous edition was in Vietnam (2019). B (Dalhousie) is wrong.

src: TSPSC Tutors in Medical Education, Dental Asst Surgeon, Civi
s: What is Navika Sagar Parikrama?
o: Joint exercises of China and Indian navies in the Indian Ocean
Indian Navy's highest award for excellence
Joint trilateral naval exercises of US, India and Japan navies
Name of the expedition by a womens group from Indian navy to circle the globe
x: Navika Sagar Parikrama (September 2017 – May 2018) was the first circumnavigation of the globe by an all-women Indian Navy crew, on INSV Tarini, led by Lt Cdr Vartika Joshi.

src: TREI-RB TGT (S2) 2023
s:
In respect of the 'Exercise Garuda VII' (2022) which of the following are correct?

A. It was held at the Air Force Station, Prayagraj

B. It was a bilateral exercise

C. Indian Air Force (IAF) and French Air & Space Force (FASF) participated in the exercise

D. The aim is to enhance operational capability of both the countries

E. The exercise provides a platform for sharing best practices
o: A, B, C and D only
B, C, D and E only
x: Garuda VII (26 October – 12 November 2022) was a bilateral exercise of the IAF and the French Air and Space Force, to enhance operational capability and share best practices – B, C, D, E correct. It was held at Air Force Station Jodhpur, not Prayagraj, so A is wrong.

src: Grama Ward Sachivalayam Category-III Ward Welfare & Developm
s: Which of the following pairs of Military exercises and the country with which India conducts them is not correctly matched?
x: Surya Kiran is India's exercise with Nepal (since 2011), not Japan, so it is the wrong pair; Hand-in-Hand (China), Mitra Shakti (Sri Lanka) and Maitree (Thailand) are correct.

src: APSLPRB Constable Prelims 2023
s:
Match the Military/Naval exercises with their participating countries.
List-I

a. SAREX-2022

b. Dharma Guardian-2022

c. Varuna-2022

d. VAJRA PRAHAR-2022
List-II
i. India-US joint military exercise
ii. Indian coast guard exercise

src: APPSC Group-1 PYQ
s:
Consider the following statements regarding ' Operation Aspides ' which was recently seen in the news:
I. It is a defensive maritime security operation to restore and safeguard freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and the Gulf.
II. Operation Aspides is a joint operation by Interpol and International Maritime Organization and was launched on 19th February, 2024. Which among the above statements is / are correct?
x: EUNAVFOR Operation Aspides, launched by the European Union on 19 February 2024, is a defensive maritime security operation for freedom of navigation in the Red Sea and the Gulf (against Houthi attacks) – I correct. It is an EU operation, not an Interpol–IMO one, so II is wrong.

src: APPSC Group-2 PYQ
s: Who propounded the concept of ' Soft Power ' in International Relations?
x: 'Soft power' – shaping others' preferences through attraction and persuasion rather than coercion – was coined by Joseph Nye (Harvard) in the late 1980s ('Bound to Lead', 1990). Huntington wrote 'Clash of Civilizations'; Butler and Tully are not IR theorists of the term.

src: State PSC
s: Which among the following is not a member of the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue an informal strategic forum?
x: The Quad (Quadrilateral Security Dialogue) is India, the US, Japan and Australia; China is not a member – Beijing calls it an 'Asian NATO'.
